'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Terrorism in France]]
**[[2022 Paris shooting]]
***Three people are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Kurds in France|Kurdish]] community center in [[Paris]], [[France]]. The perpetrator, a 69-year-old Frenchman, is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64077668 (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A police officer is killed and ten other people are injured when two [[Pakistani Taliban]] [[insurgent]]s [[Suicide attack|blow themselves up]] [[car bomb|in a car]] outside a [[police station]] in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-islamabad-bombings-taliban-c3039c4eadd53667cc589ed7681bed27 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Economy of Japan]]
***[[Japan]]'s [[Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications|internal affairs ministry]] reports that the country experienced its highest level of [[inflation]] since 1981 last month after [[Consumer price index|core consumer prices]] increased by 3.7 percent from November 2021. [https://mb.com.ph/2022/12/23/japan-inflation-at-3-7-in-november-highest-since-1981/ (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Late December 2022 North American winter storm]]
**At least 200 million people, two-thirds of the population of the [[United States]], are under [[weather warning]] advisories, with the state of [[New York (state)|New York]] issuing a [[travel ban]] due to [[extreme temperatures]]. 1.5 million people across the country are left [[power outage|without power]] and at least 28 people are killed as a result of the storm. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/12/23/us/winter-storm-snow-weather (''The New York Times'')] [https://weather.com/news/news/2022-12-23-winter-storm-elliott-blizzard-bomb-cyclone-live-updates-friday (The Weather Channel)] [https://news.sky.com/story/amp/us-bomb-cyclone-at-least-24-dead-and-hundreds-of-thousands-of-homes-without-power-in-brutal-storm-12774272 (Sky News)]
*Sixteen people are killed when a bus falls into a gorge in [[Sikkim]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indian-army-says-16-personnel-killed-road-accident-2022-12-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Zambia]]
**[[Zambia]] abolishes the [[death penalty]] effective immediately. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2468127/zambia-abolishes-death-penalty (AFP via ''The Bangkok Post'')]
*French [[serial killer]] [[Charles Sobhraj]], who received a [[life sentence]] in [[Nepal]] for murdering 12 [[Tourism in Nepal|tourists]] between 1963 and 1976, and suspected of murdering also 18 other people, is released from prison [[Compassionate release|due to his old age]] and [[Good conduct time|good behaviour]] in accordance with a [[Supreme Court of Nepal|Supreme Court]] order. He is [[Deportation|deport]]ed to [[France]] and barred from Nepal for ten years. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/serial-killer-charles-sobhraj-leaves-jail-in-nepal-news-agency-afp-3631799 (AFP via NDTV)]
